anchor.quote: fires or does not fire

legacy.note: Individual action potentials are all-or-none, despite graded transduction before threshold.

anchor.quote: action potential or no action potential, one or zero

claims.rationale: Mapping an individual spike to one or zero does not make pain a binary signal; pain is encoded through spike rate, timing, fiber type, and central processing. The binary mapping is load-bearing, mathematically misapplied, and unprovenanced.

legacy.quote: "action potential or no action potential, one or zero"
legacy.note: The binary abstraction is structurally valid at the individual spike level.

legacy.note: Pain intensity also depends on firing rate, fiber type, central modulation, context, and attention.
